message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The cause was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`. I left `migrations/` alone, as `CLAUDE.md` requires, and a search found no other `full_name` uses in `src` or `test`.
text: Fenceline: no fence crossed this turn.
